_README: Price table for the Budget Guard's pre-call estimates.
Entries with "last_verified": null are UNVERIFIED — the router REFUSES to make a
live (billable) call using one. Look the real price up in the provider's pricing
page/dashboard, put it in, and set last_verified to today (YYYY-MM-DD).
units: 'per_call' = flat USD per request. 'per_second' = USD x output duration.
supports: [...]        -> the model's ACCEPTED input field names. The adapter sends
usd_by / price_by     -> price varies by an input param (e.g. resolution tier).
price_expires         -> promo end date; the rate reads as UNVERIFIED from then.
nothing outside this list, so an unsupported parameter is
params: {stage: {...}} -> per-stage input values ('all' applies to every stage).
identity_via_image     -> the model carries persona identity through image_url, so a
persona job must supply a reference still.
fixed_durations: [..]  -> model only emits these lengths; requests snap UP and are
billed at the tier. Omit for models billing by the second.
